biggest_catch: The $1,000 tier requires a $30,000 average ledger balance in EACH of the first three statement cycles. Business accounts only; offers valid through September 30, 2026 (8 days from verification).
catches: Earn $400: open a new PNC Business Checking or Business Checking Plus account by 9/30/26; for each of the first three statement cycles, maintain a minimum average ledger balance of $2,000 AND make at least 10 total qualifying transactions.

Earn $1,000: open a new PNC Treasury Enterprise Plan or Analysis Business Checking account by 9/30/26; for each of the first three statement cycles, maintain a minimum average ledger balance of $30,000.

Aggregator (creditdonkey) adds: only available to businesses with annual revenue under $5 million; existing business checking customers, those who closed an account in the past 90 days, or those paid a promotional premium in the past 12 months are not eligible; $1,000 bonus credited within 90 days after all conditions are met (unconfirmed in the official excerpt).
Treasury Enterprise Plan has a $50 monthly account maintenance fee (waived with $30,000 average combined monthly collected balance).
